CONSUMER PRICE INDEX - AUGUST 2026
The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.4 percent
on a seasonally adjusted basis in August. Over the last 12 months, the all
items index increased 3.4 percent before seasonal adjustment.
The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in August and
increased 2.4 percent over the last 12 months.
